content_blocks.label: clause_1._Parties
content_blocks.text: The Plaintiff, Tech Innovators Corp., is a corporation duly organized and existing under the laws of Novaria, and the Defendant, Innovatek Solutions Inc., is also a corporation duly organized and existing under the laws of Novaria.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Factual_Background
content_blocks.text: Whereas, on January 1, 2024, the Plaintiff and the Defendant entered into a contract for the provision of software development services, which was to be completed by December 31, 2024.
